messages:
mira (sec-eng): rolling out expanded audit coverage in staging for KMS ops + RBAC policy evals. need docs + customer validation tests. planning to add new event types and keep compatibility for 6 months :eyes:

sam (devex): thanks — can you list the new event names and the minimal schema we should show in docs? also any breaking changes?

mira (sec-eng): new events: `kms.key_access`, `kms.key_rotation_request`, `rbac.policy_eval`. minimal payload example for `kms.key_access`:

```json
{
  "event": "kms.key_access",
  "ts": "2026-05-04T14:22:31Z",
  "actor": "service-account:inference-worker-03",
  "key_id": "projects/prod/keys/customer-123",
  "action": "decrypt",
  "result": "allowed",
  "reason": "policy_match:encrypt-decrypt-role",
  "request_id": "req_01F..."
}
```

mira (sec-eng): compatibility: existing `kms_event` umbrella field will remain for 6 months and we'll emit both `kms_event` and the new typed `event`. no field renames.

elaine (product): for customer-facing notes we should: 1) call out new event names, 2) sample payloads (sanitized), 3) migration timeline (6 months), 4) example Splunk/Datadog parsers and a quick sample query. I can draft the blurb.

ops-oncall: does this change retention or routing of audit streams to SIEMs? we don't want duplicate ingestion causing billing spikes.

mira (sec-eng): good point — in staging we're emitting a single message with both views (old umbrella + new typed). production will switch to emitting the typed event and a flag `legacy_view: true` for 30 days then off; we'll coordinate with infra to provide a sampling toggle if customers want non-duplicated streams. ops-oncall please confirm the sampling toggle.

audit-bot: automated validation run: 12/12 checks passed for schema v1.9 -> v2.0 compatibility; sample harness: `./tools/audit-validate --schema v2 --samples samples/kms/*.json` :white_check_mark:

sam (devex): for the docs page we need: a) changelog entry (short), b) field-level compatibility table, c) example parsers. i'll open a docs PR and include a `validation-kit.zip` with tests for customers. can someone review the PR copy?

mira (sec-eng): i'll add the event mapping table, and a short migration FAQ addressing common questions: "will I see duplicates?", "how long before old field retired?", "how to update parsers?". pinging @elaine for customer messaging tone.

elaine (product): once PR is in staging, i'll prepare a release note for the Console banner + support email template. include clear samples for Splunk and a Datadog JSON -> log pipeline. keep language non-technical for the banner and technical link for docs.

sam (devex): also add a small CI check that runs `tools/audit-validate` on every change to the audit schema folder. prevents regressions.

mira (sec-eng): added TODOs in the tracking ticket (INT-9871): docs PR, changelog, console banner, support email draft, sample parsers, and customer validation kit. i'll post links when PRs are up. thanks all :rocket:
